gaza-2728.council: The Security Council adopted resolution 2728 (2024) by 14 votes in favour, none against and one abstention. It demanded an immediate Ramadan ceasefire and the immediate and unconditional release of hostages.

sources.card: The United States abstained on resolution 2728 (2024). It supported the objectives of a ceasefire and hostage release and said United States, Qatar and Egypt diplomacy was still working towards a deal.
France voted in favour of resolution 2728 (2024). France said the Council must remain engaged after adoption and work towards a permanent ceasefire after Ramadan.

witnesses: The United States abstained on resolution 2728 (2024).

myanmar-2669.council: The Security Council adopted resolution 2669 (2022) by 12 votes in favour, none against and three abstentions. It demanded an immediate end to violence in Myanmar.

sources.card: China abstained on resolution 2669 (2022). China said that a presidential statement would have been more appropriate and the tone of the amended resolution still lacked balance. China backed ASEAN's leading role and its Five-Point Consensus.
Norway voted in favour of resolution 2669 (2022). Norway welcomed adoption and called for an end to attacks on civilians and a return to democratic rule.
